# appgatesdp_certificate_authority_issued_certificates (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of issued certificates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `descending` (Boolean) Whether the sorting is applied descending or ascending.
- `filter_by` (Attributes List) The filters applied to the list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_by))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `order_by` (String) The field name used to sort the list.
- `queries` (List of String) The queries applied to the list.
- `range` (String) The range applied to the list. Format: -/. 3-5/8 means, out of 8 count (query affects the total), the items between (including) the 3rd and the 5th are returned.
- `total_count` (Number) The total readable count of entities. Not influenced by the query.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) SHA256 fingerprint of the certificate.
- `id` (String) Random ID assigned to the certificate.
- `issue_time` (String) When the Controller issued the certificate.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer name of the certificate.
- `pem` (String) PEM formatted public certificate.
- `revocation_notes` (String) Free-text notes for revocation reason.
- `revocation_reason` (String) X509 certificate revocation reason. See RFC 5280.
- `revocation_time` (String) The revocation time of the certificate.
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is revoked or not.
- `serial` (String) X.509 certificate serial number.
- `subject` (String) The subject name of the certificate.
- `type` (String) Type of the certificate.
- `valid_from` (String) Since when the certificate is valid from.
- `valid_to` (String) Until when the certificate is valid.
